reason: I tried to refute the UPHELD verdict and could not; every number in it checks out. (1) experiments/RESULTS.md l.32, exp13 on 48 videos: d1/a0 0.9149, d2/a0 0.9158, d3/a0 0.9110. A parabola fit gives the optimum at S*=1.658, with 1.75 at +0.00031 and 2.25 at -0.00067. That is an old base (div 1.2, before x138), so it is weak evidence. (2) On the current-family base, the dummy lab (scratchpad r26/dummy_lab_summary.json) has exp88c DIS 1.75 at 0.92039 vs exp70g at 0.92052. That is -0.00013, +1 TP and +0.81% nodes, so a prior mean of +0.0002 is generous. (3) I re-ran the display MC (400k draws, exp85a true value ~U[0.9575,0.9585), a 0.960 display means true >= 0.9595). With mu +0.0002 and sd 0.0008, P(>=0.960)=0.063 and P(<=0.957)=0.205. With mu 0, P=0.039. With the lab-consistent mu -0.0001, P=0.030. A non-CI slot-2 file matters only at >= 0.960, and a CI file sent at 12:00Z would read after the 20:00Z tick. (4) Since the recheck was written, CONTEXT 09:19Z logged exp89r = 0.957 with DIS dd = 0, coded '?'. Rule (a) is not met, and slot 2 now defaults to UNUSED. That '?' is noise at +-0.002. It does not say DIS 2.25 is negative, so it does not trigger the 'other direction' logic. Picking 1.75 after that read would be choosing a direction from a public read, which the 12:23Z risk-stack rule excludes. The 14:12Z MORNING TABLE v1.1 (0)(i) excludes DIS 1.75 by name (CONTEXT l.3935). (5) Feasibility is NOT the blocker. At 09:27Z, a 25-35 min dummy of the already-built exp89e (never dummied) would still fit before 12:00Z, and ~3 h of GPU is left. Value and the pre-registration are what block it. On private (other embryos), the expected gain is ~0 or negative, and the extra nodes cost on every embryo through the node term. It is not a closed line in disguise; it is simply a low-value knob.
